help.faq1A: Orders screen kholein, jis delivery ko follow karna hai us par tap karein aur "Track" chunein. Aapko driver ki live location aur latest status updates dikhengi.
help.faq2Q: Mera order abhi bhi "pending" kyon hai?
help.faq2A: Pending order kisi driver dwara swikrit hone ka intezar kar raha hai. Aap assigned fleet ki jaanch kar sakte hain, apne driver se sampark kar sakte hain, ya order details screen se order radd kar sakte hain.
help.faq3Q: Main apni profile ya password kaise update karun?
help.faq3A: Menu se Settings mein jaayein. Apne credentials update karne ke liye "Password Badlein" ka upyog karein aur apne contact details refresh karne ke liye Profile screen ka upyog karein.
help.faq4Q: Maine jo phone number daala hai woh swikar n ho raha hai.
help.faq4A: Phone numbers aapke dwara registration ke samay upyog kiye gaye country code se match hone chahiye. Agar aapko abhi bhi samasya hai, toh apna poora naam aur apne account ka email dekar support se sampark karein.
help.faq5Q: Main delivery mein samasya ki report kaise karun?
help.faq5A: Order kholein, Report a Problem par tap karein aur apni samasya chunein. Aap is screen se seedhe hamari support team se bhi sampark kar sakte hain — neeche diye gaye button ka upyog karein.
